about: Reduction profiles for collectives.py (--reduce-profile): time to reduce received data before forwarding it is ns + bytes / gbps. Values are assumptions unless a source is given; add measured profiles for your systems and keep the source field honest.

hbm-ironwood.source: rate: Ironwood HBM bandwidth 7.37 TB/s (Google, public) / 3, as a reduce reads two operands and writes one through HBM; latency: assumed per-step kernel and synchronization overhead

near-network.source: assumed: an engine beside the network port (in the spirit of TPU 8i's Collectives Acceleration Engine, Hot Chips 2026, which publishes no absolute numbers) that reduces at about link rate with a short pipeline

switch.source: assumed: an in-switch reducer (SHARP-style) that keeps up with its links; latency only. Use with msg-innet
